title: Big etale module sheaves and their canonical direct-image functors
statement: Work in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal C\to\mathit{Sch}/S$ a category fibred in groupoids [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Its big etale site has the total objects and arrows of [def-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-algebra], with covering families lying over jointly surjective etale scheme families [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. The regular-function presheaf $\mathcal O_{\mathcal C}(x)=\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$ for $x$ over $T$ is an etale sheaf. Use its category of all module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with no cartesian or quasi-coherent condition. Lift the section rings canonically by ULift to the common universe containing schemes, site objects and arrows, as in [def-pur-cochain-coefficient-universe-transport]. Sheafification exists there, its equivalences are exactly the locally bijective maps, and this module category is abelian and admits injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For a functor $a:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ over schemes between such fibred categories, precomposition preserves sheaves, with the canonical identification $\mathcal O_{\mathcal D}=a^{-1}\mathcal O_{\mathcal C}$. Define $a^*$ by this literal precomposition. It has a right adjoint $a_*$, characterized uniquely up to natural isomorphism by $\operatorname{Hom}(a^*M,N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(M,a_*N)$; on a test $x$ over $T$, this is compatible sections $\Gamma(\mathcal D\times_{\mathcal C}T,N|)$, with base-change restrictions and the usual regular-function action. The right adjoint is additive. Define $R^ia_*$ for $i\in\mathbf N$ by applying it to an injective resolution and taking degree-$i$ cohomology.
